cd /app && python - <<'PY'
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

with open('benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

lcoe = data['lcoe_trends']['data']
cap = data['installed_capacity']['data']
subs = data['fossil_fuel_subsidies']['data']
fossil = data['fossil_fuel_lcoe_range']['data']

years = [d['year'] for d in lcoe]
solar = [d['solar_pv'] for d in lcoe]
wind = [d['onshore_wind'] for d in lcoe]
battery = [d['battery_storage'] for d in lcoe]
solar_cap = [d['solar_pv_gw'] for d in cap]
wind_cap = [d['onshore_wind_gw'] for d in cap]
sub_total = [d['total_subsidies_bn'] for d in subs]

f_years = [d['year'] for d in fossil]
f_low = [min(d['gas_ccgt_low'], d['coal_low']) for d in fossil]
f_high = [max(d['gas_ccgt_high'], d['coal_high']) for d in fossil]

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(15, 9), dpi=150)

# Professional editorial palette
c_solar = '#E69F00'
c_wind = '#0072B2'
c_battery = '#7A3E9D'
c_sub = '#8C8C8C'
c_fossil = '#B24A4A'

# Fossil LCOE range band
ax1.fill_between(f_years, f_low, f_high, color=c_fossil, alpha=0.18, label='New fossil generation LCOE range (USD/MWh)')

# LCOE lines
ax1.plot(years, solar, color=c_solar, linewidth=3, label='Solar PV LCOE (USD/MWh)')
ax1.plot(years, wind, color=c_wind, linewidth=3, label='Onshore wind LCOE (USD/MWh)')
ax1.plot(years, battery, color=c_battery, linewidth=3, label='Battery storage LCOE (USD/MWh, 4h)')

ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('LCOE (2023 real USD/MWh)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_xlim(2010, 2024)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1150)

# Capacity axis
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(years, solar_cap, color=c_solar, linestyle='--', linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.9, label='Solar PV capacity (GW)')
ax2.plot(years, wind_cap, color=c_wind, linestyle='--', linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.9, label='Onshore wind capacity (GW)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Cumulative installed capacity (GW)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 2100)

# Subsidy bars axis (offset on right)
ax3 = ax1.twinx()
ax3.spines['right'].set_position(('axes', 1.09))
ax3.bar(years, sub_total, width=0.58, color=c_sub, alpha=0.25, label='Fossil fuel subsidies (Billion USD, nominal)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fossil fuel subsidies (Billion USD, nominal)', fontsize=12, color='#555555')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', colors='#555555')
ax3.set_ylim(0, 760)

# Crossover annotations
ax1.scatter([2021], [39], color=c_solar, s=55, zorder=6)
ax1.annotate('Solar crossover\n(2021: $39/MWh < fossil range)',
             xy=(2021, 39), xytext=(2017.4, 165),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c_solar, lw=1.5),
             fontsize=10, color=c_solar, ha='left')

ax1.scatter([2023], [37], color=c_wind, s=55, zorder=6)
ax1.annotate('Wind crossover\n(2023: $37/MWh < fossil range)',
             xy=(2023, 37), xytext=(2020.1, 245),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c_wind, lw=1.5),
             fontsize=10, color=c_wind, ha='left')

# Battery collapse annotation
ax1.annotate('Battery LCOE: $1,100 → $102/MWh\n(−91% since 2010)',
             xy=(2024, 102), xytext=(2011.5, 940),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c_battery, lw=1.5),
             fontsize=10, color=c_battery)

# Solar acceleration annotation
ax2.annotate('Solar capacity acceleration\nafter 2018',
             xy=(2024, 1950), xytext=(2018.2, 1500),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c_solar, lw=1.4),
             fontsize=10, color=c_solar)

# Title/subtitle
fig.suptitle('Renewable Cost Revolution vs Fossil Subsidy Persistence (2010–2024)',
             fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', y=0.97)
ax1.set_title('Falling solar, wind, and battery LCOE with surging clean capacity, contrasted against persistently high fossil fuel subsidies',
              fontsize=11, pad=12)

# Combined legend
h1, l1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
h2, l2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
h3, l3 = ax3.get_legend_handles_labels()
legend = ax1.legend(h1+h2+h3, l1+l2+l3, ncol=2, fontsize=9.5, frameon=True,
                    loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 0.995), borderaxespad=0.4)
legend.get_frame().set_alpha(0.95)

# Footnote
fig.text(0.01, 0.012,
         'Units: LCOE in 2023 real USD/MWh; capacity in GW; subsidies in nominal billion USD. Source: provided benchmark datasets.',
         fontsize=9, color='#444444')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 0.9, 0.93])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', bbox_inches='tight')
PY

import json, math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

with open('benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

lcoe = data['lcoe_trends']['data']
cap = data['installed_capacity']['data']
subs = data['fossil_fuel_subsidies']['data']
fossil = data['fossil_fuel_lcoe_range']['data']

years = [d['year'] for d in lcoe]
solar = [d['solar_pv'] for d in lcoe]
wind = [d['onshore_wind'] for d in lcoe]
battery = [d['battery_storage'] for d in lcoe]
solar_cap = [d['solar_pv_gw'] for d in cap]
wind_cap = [d['onshore_wind_gw'] for d in cap]
sub_total = [d['total_subsidies_bn'] for d in subs]

f_years = [d['year'] for d in fossil]
f_low = [min(d['gas_ccgt_low'], d['coal_low']) for d in fossil]
f_high = [max(d['gas_ccgt_high'], d['coal_high']) for d in fossil]

W, H = 1800, 1100
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), 'white')
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

try:
    font_title = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 44)
    font_sub = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 23)
    font_label = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 20)
    font_small = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 16)
    font_legend = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 18)
except:
    font_title = font_sub = font_label = font_small = font_legend = ImageFont.load_default()

left, top, right, bottom = 130, 170, 1460, 900
pw, ph = right-left, bottom-top

# Colors
c_solar=(230,159,0)
c_wind=(0,114,178)
c_batt=(122,62,157)
c_sub=(145,145,145)
c_foss=(178,74,74)
black=(20,20,20)

# Helpers
xmin, xmax = 2010, 2024

def x_map(y):
    return left + (y-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*pw

def y_lcoe(v):
    return bottom - (v/1150)*ph

def y_cap(v):
    return bottom - (v/2100)*ph

def y_sub(v):
    return bottom - (v/760)*ph

# grid
for v in range(0, 1200, 100):
    y=y_lcoe(v)
    d.line([(left,y),(right,y)], fill=(235,235,235), width=1)
for y in years:
    x=x_map(y)
    if y%2==0:
        d.line([(x,top),(x,bottom)], fill=(242,242,242), width=1)

# Fossil band polygon
pts=[]
for yr,hi in zip(f_years,f_high):
    pts.append((x_map(yr), y_lcoe(hi)))
for yr,lo in reversed(list(zip(f_years,f_low))):
    pts.append((x_map(yr), y_lcoe(lo)))
d.polygon(pts, fill=(c_foss[0],c_foss[1],c_foss[2],60), outline=(200,140,140))

# subsidy bars
barw = pw/len(years)*0.58
for yr,val in zip(years, sub_total):
    x=x_map(yr)
    d.rectangle([(x-barw/2, y_sub(val)), (x+barw/2, bottom)], fill=(210,210,210), outline=None)

# line drawer

def draw_line(xs, ys, color, width=4, dash=False):
    pts=[(x_map(x), ys(v)) for x,v in zip(xs, ysvals)]

# Draw lines manually
for arr,color,mapper,w in [
    (solar,c_solar,y_lcoe,5),
    (wind,c_wind,y_lcoe,5),
    (battery,c_batt,y_lcoe,5),
    (solar_cap,c_solar,y_cap,4),
    (wind_cap,c_wind,y_cap,4),
]:
    pts=[(x_map(y), mapper(v)) for y,v in zip(years,arr)]
    d.line(pts, fill=color, width=w, joint='curve')
    # dashed for capacity via segment skipping
    if arr in (solar_cap, wind_cap):
        # overwrite with white gaps to mimic dashes
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            if i%2==1:
                d.line([pts[i],pts[i+1]], fill='white', width=w-1)
                d.line([pts[i],pts[i+1]], fill=(245,245,245), width=max(1,w-3))

# axes
d.line([(left,top),(left,bottom)], fill=black, width=2)
d.line([(left,bottom),(right,bottom)], fill=black, width=2)
d.line([(right,top),(right,bottom)], fill=(90,90,90), width=2)
d.line([(right+110,top),(right+110,bottom)], fill=(90,90,90), width=2)

# ticks and labels
for v in range(0, 1200, 200):
    y=y_lcoe(v); d.line([(left-8,y),(left,y)], fill=black, width=2)
    d.text((left-62,y-10), str(v), fill=black, font=font_small)
for v in [0,500,1000,1500,2000]:
    y=y_cap(v); d.line([(right,y),(right+8,y)], fill=(90,90,90), width=2)
    d.text((right+12,y-10), str(v), fill=(60,60,60), font=font_small)
for v in [0,200,400,600]:
    y=y_sub(v); d.line([(right+102,y),(right+110,y)], fill=(90,90,90), width=2)
    d.text((right+114,y-10), str(v), fill=(60,60,60), font=font_small)
for yr in years:
    x=x_map(yr)
    d.line([(x,bottom),(x,bottom+8)], fill=black, width=2)
    if yr%2==0:
        d.text((x-18,bottom+13), str(yr), fill=black, font=font_small)

# titles
d.text((130,40), 'Renewable Cost Revolution vs Fossil Subsidy Persistence (2010–2024)', fill=black, font=font_title)
d.text((130,95), 'Falling solar, wind, and battery LCOE with surging clean capacity, contrasted against persistently high fossil fuel subsidies', fill=(50,50,50), font=font_sub)

# axis labels
d.text((520,965), 'Year', fill=black, font=font_label)
d.text((20,420), 'LCOE (2023 real USD/MWh)', fill=black, font=font_label)
d.text((1490,390), 'Cumulative capacity (GW)', fill=(60,60,60), font=font_label)
d.text((1600,365), 'Fossil subsidies\n(Billion USD, nominal)', fill=(60,60,60), font=font_small)

# Legend
lx, ly = 150, 180
items=[
    ('Solar PV LCOE', c_solar),
    ('Onshore wind LCOE', c_wind),
    ('Battery storage LCOE (4h)', c_batt),
    ('New fossil generation LCOE range', c_foss),
    ('Solar PV capacity (GW, dashed)', c_solar),
    ('Onshore wind capacity (GW, dashed)', c_wind),
    ('Fossil fuel subsidies (Billion USD)', (200,200,200)),
]
for i,(lab,col) in enumerate(items):
    y=ly+i*30
    d.rectangle([(lx,y+5),(lx+22,y+20)], fill=col, outline=(120,120,120))
    d.text((lx+30,y), lab, fill=black, font=font_legend)

sx, sy = x_map(2021), y_lcoe(39)
